Samir: opened a small PR that stitches a KV-replay guidance section into the 429/timeouts troubleshooting page + a compact snippet covering streaming resume + short-replay fallback. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/docs/pull/1589
Ally: nice. can you add a single-line decision rule: 'prefix-resume first for latency/cost; short replay when prefix misses or consistency matters'? keeps the doc actionable.
Samir: added that exact line. also included a tiny pseudo-snippet (python) showing streaming with a short replay window on 429.
Connor: quick nit: add a short note about de-duplication (drop overlapping tokens) and about context-window loss. suggest: 'If truncation omits important context, prefer replay with conservative max_tokens and a quick post-replay sanity check.'
samir: updated the copy to include both points. snippet below:
```python
# streaming + kv prefix + quick short replay on 429 (pseudo)
prefix = kv.get(session_key)
try:
    for chunk in client.stream_generate(prompt, kv_cache=prefix):
        ui.emit(chunk.text)
        prefix.last_idx = chunk.last_idx
except TooManyRequests:
    # short replay overlapping the last few tokens, then dedupe
    start = max(0, prefix.last_idx - 6)
    resp = client.generate(prompt, kv_range=(start, prefix.last_idx), max_tokens=64)
    ui.emit(resp.text[prefix.overlap_chars:])
```
